name: ZacSecurity
author: Zaclabs

sections.description:
zacsecurity enhances your website’s content protection by making it more difficult for users to copy text or access context menus.

Features:
– Disable right-click functionality on your website.
– Block “Ctrl+C” to prevent content copying.
– Simple settings page for enabling or disabling the protection.
– Lightweight and easy to use, with no impact on site performance.

Why Use zacsecurity?
If you are a content creator, blogger, or website owner concerned about unauthorized content copying, zacsecurity provides an easy-to-implement solution to add a layer of protection.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit ZacLab Support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zacsecurity folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory using FTP or the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > zacsecurity to enable or disable the content protection features.
sections.faq:
Can I enable or disable protection dynamically?

Yes, you can easily enable or disable the protection from the settings page under Settings > zacsecurity.

Does zacsecurity completely prevent content copying?

While zacsecurity makes copying content significantly harder, determined users with technical skills may still find ways to bypass these restrictions.

Will zacsecurity affect the performance of my website?

No, zacsecurity is designed to be lightweight and has minimal impact on your website’s performance.
